# AJIO Marketplace Canonical Pack — Production Final Clean v17

## 0. Issue Register and Curation Notes

```yaml
issue_register:
- issue_id: layout.ordered_card_pack
  status: resolved
  resolution: Cards are grouped by standard card-type order; edges are grouped by edge type.
```

## 1. Introduction and Scope Boundary

This file is rendered for deterministic curation review and graph ingestion. Runtime/client cards are out of scope for reusable domain packs.

## 2. Validation Contract

Locked full-spectrum validation applies: structural checks, claim consistency, curation quality, SQL blueprint checks, deterministic edge coverage, and no warnings.
